subtitle: Books and copies in your library.

columns.title: Title
columns.author: Author
empty.title: No books yet
empty.description: Start by adding your first book — type its ISBN and we'll look it up for you, or fill in the details by hand.
book.title: Add a book
book.subtitle: Type an ISBN to pre-fill the details, or enter them by hand.
book.isbn.hint: We use OpenLibrary to pre-fill title, authors, year, publisher and pages.
book.isbn.label: ISBN
book.isbnTooShort: An ISBN is 10 or 13 digits. Double-check what you typed.
book.isbnFound: Found it — details filled in below.
book.isbnNotFound: OpenLibrary doesn't have this one. Fill in the details by hand below.
book.archiveConfirmBody: Archiving hides the book from the catalog but keeps its history. Active copies must be returned first.
book.archivedHint: It won't appear in catalog search. Restore to lend it out again.
book.copyBarcodeHint: Letters, digits, dashes and underscores; must be unique across active copies.
book.noCopies: No copies yet. Add one to start lending.
book.errors.checkFields: Some fields need a closer look — see the messages below.
help.title: About the catalog
help.intro: The catalog is every book your library owns. Each row is one title; click into it to see the individual copies you have on the shelf.
help.do1: Search by title, author, or ISBN — the search is accent-insensitive, so “πατωντας” finds “Πατώντας”.
help.do2: Click “Add a book” to enter one by hand or look it up by ISBN.
help.do3: Click any title to edit, add custom fields, or manage copies.
help.countsBody: The “Available” column shows how many copies aren't currently checked out or reserved. The plan you're on caps the total titles in your catalog — you can see your current usage from the Billing page.
book.noChanges: Nothing changed, so nothing was saved.
book.fieldNotOnRecord: This record has no such field. Adding one is a cataloguing decision — use the full editor when it arrives.
book.fixedFieldsLater: Language and the other coded values live at fixed positions inside the record and are edited in the full MARC editor.
book.editHint: The five fields that map to one place in the record each. The rest is edited in the full MARC editor.
book.needsReviewHint: It came in from an import that could not read part of it cleanly. Check the details before lending the copies out.
book.copyLocationHint: Pick a branch first — a shelving location belongs to one.
book.copyBarcodeOptionalHint: Optional. Leave it empty to catalogue the copy now and label it later.
book.moreCopies: Showing the first {count} copies of this title.
book.withdrawConfirmBody: The copy leaves the live catalogue and its barcode becomes free to re-use. Its loan history is kept.
book.deleteConfirmBody: The record stops appearing in the catalogue, and anyone harvesting your catalogue is told it was deleted. The record itself is kept, with its history and your reason.
book.deleteReasonHint: Kept with the record permanently. Write what a colleague would need to know in a year.
book.addCopyNoBranches: Add a branch before adding copies — every copy belongs to one.
book.addCopyNoItemTypes: Add an item type before adding copies — it is what decides the loan rules.
book.addCopyNoLocations: Add a shelving location before adding copies — it is where the copy sits.
book.errors.reasonTooShort: Write a reason of at least three characters.
book.errors.copyFieldsRequired: Pick a branch, a shelving location and an item type.
